decision: Treat Dyniku 0.3.0 as a breaking deployment release that adopts the ZimaOS-first Compose contract and the active host port 65000 everywhere.
rationale: The primary ZimaOS import must be standalone, contain no interpolation variables, expose a replaceable setup-secret placeholder directly, and pin the release image by version and digest.
consequences: New ZimaOS installations must replace the synthetic ISHIKU_SETUP_SECRET placeholder before first start.
Existing ZimaOS installations must migrate from the setup-secret file mount to the inline one-time setup secret only when recreating an uninitialized deployment.
The published host port is 65000; the compatible container port remains 8507.
All shipped Compose profiles use a direct synthetic ISHIKU_SETUP_SECRET replacement value; the application retains secret-file input only as an optional compatibility feature.
Existing persistent data must be retained and assigned to runtime UID/GID 10001 before the hardened container is started.
Rollback pins Dyniku 0.2.6 by digest and restores the previous Compose file after backing up persistent data.
